acceptanceCriteria.text: Every existing file and directory under `docs/` is classified as keep, move, rename, merge, archive/history, delete-candidate, or move-out-of-docs, with a reason.
The responsibility-oriented top-level structure is implemented, or any deviation is explicitly justified in the PR.
`docs/README.md` is the only ordinary Markdown file directly under `docs/` and serves as the documentation entry point.
Each top-level category has an explicit responsibility and placement rule.
All listed migration-map paths are moved/renamed according to the agreed information architecture unless the PR documents a stronger content-based destination.
Existing ADR numbering/history is preserved under `docs/decisions/`.
Point-in-time dogfood, experiment, and benchmark evidence is separated from current normative documentation.
Historical release documentation is separated from current release operations.
Non-document fixtures under `docs/` are moved out where practical or explicitly justified.
All Japanese prose under `docs/**` is translated to English without changing normative semantics.
Repository documentation/governance documents an English-only/default-English policy.
Repository-internal links, README references, scripts, package metadata, CI references, source comments, and other moved-path consumers are updated.
A mechanical check rejects new unclassified files directly under `docs/`, with `docs/README.md` as the intended exception.
The mechanical rule is integrated into the existing governance/CI standards path rather than creating an unrelated duplicate authority.
Documentation placement/language rules are discoverable from `docs/README.md` and repository governance documentation.

issue.title: Reorganize docs information architecture and enforce English-only documentation
